newsitem.title: JAPAN: KDD, Toyota affiliate agree to telecom tie-up.
newsitem.headline: KDD, Toyota affiliate agree to telecom tie-up.

text.p: Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co (KDD) and Toyota Motor Corp affiliate Teleway Japan Corp said on Tuesday that they had agreed on a tie-up in telecommunications services.
KDD offers both domestic and international telecommunications services while Teleway offers long-distance domestic telecommunications services.
The two companies said in a statement that they would jointly sell both international and domestic services and offer their discount programmes at their units.
They said they would implement their plans as soon as possible.
They added they would also consider connecting their networks and jointly building telecommunications facilities.
KDD said on Monday that it had agreed with another domestic long-distance telecommunications company DDI Corp on a business tie-up.
KDD and DDI said they would offer a cut of about 20 percent in international and domestic phone rates to individual users from October.
They said they would also jointly set up facilities, develop multimedia products and connect their services.
